## Scoring Engine

### Assessment Fields -> Scoring

| Step | Field | Scoring | Weights | Summary | Notes |
|------|-------|:---:|:---:|:---:|-------|
| 1 | taskComplexity | - | - | - | Pre-screening |
| 1 | useCase | - | - | - | Redundant with primaryUseCases |
| 1 | organizationSize | fallback | Y | - | Derives conversation volume |
| 1 | industry | - | - | - | Not wired |
| 2 | hasExistingPlatform | - | - | - | Not wired |
| 2 | existingPlatforms | - | - | - | Not wired |
| 2 | currentStack | Y | Y | Y | cloudNative match |
| 2 | integrationNeeds | Y | Y | - | supportedIntegrations match |
| 3 | primaryUseCases | Y | Y | Y | useCaseStrengths match |
| 3 | complianceRequirements | Y | Y | Y | complianceCerts match |
| 3 | timeline | Y | - | - | TIMELINE_TIER_FIT lookup |
| 4 | budgetRange | Y | Y | Y | Budget penalty + weight boost |
| 4 | teamTechnicalLevel | Y | Y | Y | TEAM_TIER_FIT + low-code bonus |
| 4 | expectedMonthlyConversations | Y | - | - | Feeds TCO calculator |
| 4 | decisionMakers | - | Y | - | Minor weight influence |

### Five Criteria

| Criterion | Measures | Source | Direction |
|-----------|----------|--------|:---------:|
| integrationFit | Integrations supported | integrationNeeds vs supportedIntegrations | Higher=better |
| complianceMatch | Cert coverage | complianceRequirements vs complianceCerts | Higher=better |
| budgetFit | Actual annual cost | TCO calculator with real pricing | **Lower=better** |
| featureMatch | Use case alignment | primaryUseCases vs useCaseStrengths | Higher=better |
| stackCompatibility | Cloud+team+timeline fit | cloudNative + TEAM/TIMELINE lookup tables | Higher=better |

### Budget Penalty

SAW is compensatory. This penalty prevents recommending $200K platforms to $10K budgets.

    overRatio = estimatedAnnualCost / budgetCeiling
    if estimatedAnnualCost > budgetCeiling x 2:
      penalty = min(40, floor(overRatio x 5))
      totalScore = max(0, totalScore - penalty)

    Budget ceilings:
      under-10k  = $10,000
      10k-50k    = $50,000
      50k-200k   = $200,000
      200k-plus  = $500,000

### Weight Derivation

    Base: 0.15 each x 5 = 0.75
    Dynamic allocation of remaining 0.25:
      integrationFit    += min(0.15, integrationCount x 0.03)
      complianceMatch   += min(0.12, complianceCount x 0.04)
      budgetFit         += {under-10k: 0.12, 10k-50k: 0.08, 50k-200k: 0.03}
      featureMatch      += min(0.10, useCaseCount x 0.025)
      stackCompatibility += min(0.10, stackCount x 0.02)
    MAX_WEIGHT: 0.35 per criterion
    Normalized to sum = 1.0

### Final Score

    totalScore = round(SUM(weight_i x normalized_i) x 100)
    Then budget penalty applied if applicable
    Result: integer 0-100
